map.和弦多从音阶三度叠置而来；如大调 I 级用 1/3/5 级音，vii° 用 7/: Chords are usually built by stacking scale degrees in thirds. For example a major tonic chord uses degrees 1, 3 and 5 while vii° uses degrees 7, 2 and 4, so knowing scales explains where most chords come from.
map.键盘黑键规律怎么记？: How Do You Memorize the Black-Key Pattern?
map.一组 12 键中黑键两两/三三分组，对应半音变化；C 大调只白键（无黑），每升调: Within a group of 12 keys the black keys group in pairs or threes, matching the semitone changes. C major uses white keys only (no sharps), and each added sharp in the key signature brings one more black key, landing on notes such as #F and #C.
